notes: No language/context/typo operators. Search direct uses shipped catalog and optional bounded integer preferences; wrapper uses EmojiSearchQuery and optional recents+tone map base->variant. Fixture constructs decoded catalog with injected optional s, ignores aliases for absent values, then direct search. Empty acceptable allowed only with expectEmpty true and role control. maxRank is positive <=60. equivalentTo requires identical ordered output; forbidden prohibits any listed output. All supported actions/parameters must be exercised before seal. Contextual suggestions, lookup, invalid JSON, duplicate catalog bases, nonempty wrapper limits>60 and raw buffer truncation semantics are outside blind schema, separately audited. Unique base values required in fixtures. Unavailable never passes.
grammarAuthority: Exact field types, bounds and reference rules are specified normatively in api-map.md; this descriptor is read together with that map, never alone.
